value.rationale: The full arbitrary-rank Cartan product class is a natural gap explicitly exposed in Kiri’s operator-ball program: the new exact constant one is unconditional and optimal even when bounded H-infinity Gleason division is not available. The sharp dimension-two/three transition for single non-disc factors is motivated by existing size-three failures, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The structural two-point Schwarz–Pick mechanism is reusable for homogeneous noncommutative ball domains.
